messages:
ivy: Noticed an odd pattern where our router sometimes charges the proxy key even when exchange succeeds shortly after. customers are confused + CS tickets piling up.

omar: Seen it. It's the attribution ordering + async exchange. Router picks a key early and we don't re-attribute later.

claire: Idea: attach an attribution_confidence score to each request (0-100). If confidence < 80 and path hits /v1/exchange we mark as 'probable' and surface differently in billing/console.

ivy: Interesting. Instead of waiting and risking latency, flag low-confidence entries so CS knows "possible reattribution". How compute confidence?

omar: heuristics: presence of X-Effective-Principal header -> +40, token_exchange span exists & completed before routing -> +40, exchange-cache hit -> +20. sum cap at 100. fallback attribution gets low score.

console-team: UX: we can add a small colored chip next to attributed_entity: green(>=90): "attributed", amber(50-89): "probable", red(<50): "fallback". Clicking expands to show the attribution_score breakdown and trace link. Admin-only toggle.

sec: +1 for admin gating. Also require audit entry that records attribution_score and which signals were used. retention policy? keep score in audit for 30d.

iv y: (typo) sorry ivy: we should still emit telemetry metrics: auth.attribution.score_bucket and auth.attribution.reattribution_count when re-attribution happens.

omar: two operational modes: 1) conservative (score only), 2) aggressive (wait up to 50ms if score < 80). behind flag `auth.attrib.mode=conservative|aggressive`. Start conservative.

claire: console addition: filter by attribution_chip and a saved view "Potential reattribution" listing amber+red with trace links and exchange_latency column. default collapsed.

oncall-bot: ALERT: spike in fallback billing events for partner:key-44 (67 in 10m). tagging thread 7809123456.

ivy: action items: omar implement score calc + metrics, claire prototype console chip + breakdown (admin-only), sec update audit schema + retention, ops add alert for reattribution_count. we'll trial conservative mode for 1 week.

om ar: I'll open PRs and include test vectors (exchange finished before routing, after routing, cache hit).

claire: Mockup ready, will paste link in PR. privacy note: do not surface other org ids in the chip detail unless admin.

ivy: Thanks team. I'll coordinate CS note: "why you might see a probable attribution" and include steps. :thumbsup:
